title: Experiences from Creating a Benchmark for Sentiment Classification for Varieties of English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Precision, Recall, F1-score) of fine-tuned BERT-based models on sentiment classification tasks using Google Places reviews sourced from different English-speaking locales (Standard American, Australian, British, and Indian English) to measure performance discrepancies and bias toward high-resource inner-circle language varieties.
